doc.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Television, vocal albums and orchestral craft
title: Jo + Jazz with Ellington sidemen
summary: For Jo Stafford's album Mandel used Ben Webster, Lawrence Brown, Harry Carney and Johnny Hodges while Ellington was on a European trip.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Now David's record was done around – you did those two with David…
Then there was one called, Jo + Jazz, with Jo Stafford.

Oh that was nice, we got to use some good musicians on there like, Ben Webster, I mean all the records used good musicians, you know, I got the best guys I could but here we got to use a lot of guys out of Duke’s band.
Like Ray Nance and Ben Webster.

Didn’t have Ray Nance, we had Ben Webster, we had Lawrence Brown, you know it was just great having these people, Harry Carney. And Duke was on one of his periodic European trips where he didn’t take the band and I got to use them. And let’s see, Hodges [Johnny] had come back, so he was laying around.
